limitations: Nearest source pixel on a250m spherical-AEQD sample lattice; not250m sensor resolution. Native3arcsecond DSM includes vegetation/buildings, edits and external infill.
Water/void nodes excluded under a declared land-only routing scenario. Other hazards, access, boulders, bearing strength, traction and wheel-soil mechanics are unassessed.
Graph edges test sampled elevation differences, not continuous terrain safety. Diagonal corner cutting is prohibited. Neither a landing certification nor a field route clearance.
